historical_references.context: Arda bin al-Harith was a chieftain of the Banu Amir tribe, who was one of the early supporters of Islam in Mecca. He embraced Islam before the migration of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to Medina. He was known for his generosity and hospitality and was considered one of the protectors of the Muslim community in Mecca during the early years of Islam.
